Reliable and Efficient Pumping Solutions

CI (Cast Iron) Rotary Gear Pump

At Rotozest, we manufacture and supply high-quality Cast Iron (CI) rotary gear pumps designed to deliver reliable and efficient performance across a wide range of industrial applications. Built to last, our CI rotary gear pumps are engineered with precision, making them the preferred choice for industries that handle viscous fluids such as oil, lubricants, chemicals, and other liquids requiring smooth and steady flow. Whether you need a pump for chemical processing, lubrication systems, or oil transfer, our CI rotary gear pumps offer unmatched durability and efficiency.

Request a Quote Download Brochure

What is a CI Rotary Gear Pump?

A Cast Iron (CI) rotary gear pump is a type of positive displacement pump that uses the meshing of gears to transfer fluid from the inlet to the outlet. The gears trap fluid in the spaces between the teeth and move it smoothly through the system. The robust cast iron construction ensures high strength, long service life, and the ability to handle a wide variety of fluids, including high-viscosity materials. This makes CI rotary gear pumps suitable for demanding industrial environments, providing consistent and reliable performance.

Key Features

Durable Construction

Our CI rotary gear pumps are made from premium-grade cast iron, known for its excellent durability, resistance to wear, and ability to withstand harsh conditions. This ensures a longer lifespan even when handling abrasive or corrosive fluids.

High Efficiency

Engineered for smooth operation, our pumps are designed to offer high efficiency with minimal maintenance. They ensure steady fluid flow, even at varying pressures, making them ideal for a wide range of industrial applications.

Versatile Applications

Rotozest CI rotary gear pumps can handle a variety of fluids, including oils, syrups, chemicals, and lubricants. Their ability to work with high-viscosity fluids makes them suitable for industries such as oil and gas, chemicals, and more.

Leak-Proof Design

Our pumps are designed with advanced sealing systems to prevent leakage, ensuring a safe and clean working environment. This also minimizes the risk of contamination and product loss.

Easy to Install

With a compact design and easy installation process, our CI rotary gear pumps fit seamlessly into existing systems. They require minimal maintenance and are built for long-term, trouble-free operation.

Cost-Effective Solution

Rotozest CI Rotary Gear Pumps offer a cost-effective solution without compromising on quality or performance. Their durable cast iron construction and high-efficiency design help reduce operational costs.

Applications

Rotozest’s CI rotary gear pumps are used across a wide range of industries, including:

Oil and Gas

Ideal for the transfer of fuel, lubricating oils, and other petrochemical fluids.

Chemical Processing

Efficiently handles various chemicals, ensuring smooth and leak-free operation.

Food and Beverage

Suitable for transferring high-viscosity food products such as syrups, oils, and molasses.

Agriculture

Used for irrigation systems and the transfer of fertilizers and other agricultural chemicals.

Lubrication Systems

Perfect for circulating lubricants in machinery, ensuring optimal performance and longevity.

Why Choose Rotozest CI Rotary Gear Pumps?

Proven Durability

Our CI rotary gear pumps are built to last, offering years of reliable service with minimal maintenance.

Precision Engineering

Each pump is designed with precision to ensure smooth operation, high efficiency, and minimal energy consumption.

Custom Solutions

We offer customized solutions to meet the specific needs of your industry and application.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

faq.q: What are Cast Iron gear pumps and where are they used?
faq.a: Cast Iron gear pumps are robust positive displacement pumps made from durable cast iron material, designed for efficiently transferring viscous liquids like oils, syrups, chemicals, and lubricants across industrial applications such as oil & gas, chemical processing, food & beverage, and agriculture. They offer reliable performance and long service life, making them ideal for heavy-duty fluid handling needs.

faq.q: What makes a CI rotary gear pump different from other gear pumps?
faq.a: A CI rotary gear pump uses intermeshing gears inside a cast iron housing to move fluids smoothly and consistently. The CI (cast iron) construction provides excellent strength, durability, and resistance to wear, making it suitable for handling viscous and semi-viscous liquids in demanding industrial environments.

faq.q: Why should I choose Rotozest as my CI rotary gear pump supplier in all India?
faq.a: Rotozest has established itself as a trusted CI rotary gear pump supplier in all India by offering high-quality Cast Iron gear pumps backed by stringent quality control, customized solutions, and reliable after-sales service for diverse industrial applications.

faq.q: Can you explain the typical applications of a CI rotary gear pump?
faq.a: CI rotary gear pumps are widely used for transferring viscous fluids such as fuel oil, lubricating oil, syrups, paints, and chemical products. Their rugged cast iron build ensures consistent flow and high reliability even under harsh operational conditions.

faq.q: How do I find a reliable CI gear pump dealer in all India?
faq.a: You can find a reliable CI gear pump dealer in all India by choosing established industrial pump providers with a strong national distribution network, positive customer reviews, and dedicated technical support. Rotozest serves as a reputable dealer, supplying quality Cast Iron gear pumps across India with professional service.

faq.q: What should I consider when selecting a Cast Iron gear pump?
faq.a: When choosing a Cast Iron gear pump, consider factors such as flow rate, pressure requirements, viscosity of the fluid being pumped, operating temperature, and overall build quality. A well-engineered CI gear pump ensures smooth operation, high efficiency, and minimal maintenance.

faq.q: Do you offer CI gear pump fast delivery in all India?
faq.a:
Yes, we offer fast and reliable delivery of CI (Cast Iron) Gear Pumps across India. As a trusted supplier and dealer, we understand the importance of minimizing downtime in industrial operations, so we ensure quick dispatch and secure shipping for urgent requirements.

We deliver to major industrial states including Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Gujarat, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Odisha, Punjab, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and West Bengal, along with other regions across India.

Our logistics network is designed to provide timely and efficient delivery, helping your operations run smoothly without delays.

faq.q: How does a CI rotary gear pump benefit industrial operations?
faq.a: A CI rotary gear pump delivers precise, pulse-free fluid flow that enhances process consistency, reduces operational costs, and improves productivity, especially when handling thick or viscous liquids. The robust cast iron construction also extends service life in demanding industrial conditions.
